titulo: The party starts when I arrive
alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A pink entryway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes strolls in from the left with total confidence. A light blue figure at the right widens its eyes and bounces. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays on screen: the party starts when i arrive. ask anyone.
